answer: Mechanism: copper-trace echo PUF. Each agent contains a PCB whose copper traces and violet-cured dielectric coating yield unique analog echoes to random electrical pulse challenges; enrollment stores challenge–response pairs from time-domain reflectometry and violet-laser speckle. A Sybil operator must field many distinct physical boards matching each stored echo. Cloning one ID requires invasive physical characterization of trace/coating randomness; copied software fails challenge-response. Cost: per-agent hardware fabrication plus lab-grade PUF cloning.
